# AetioMed

> AetioMed is a self-hostable backend service that uses large language models to generate realistic, internally consistent synthetic medical cases for medical education. Given an ICD-11 code or a diagnosis name, it returns a structured virtual patient case as schema-validated JSON: patient, chief complaint, anamnesis (medical history) and a diagnostic workup with procedure results.

Key facts:

- Audience: medical educators, medical schools, virtual-patient and e-learning platforms, researchers in AI for medical education.
- Not for clinical use: cases are fictional; output is not medical advice. No real patient data is used.
- Outline-first generation: one judged case blueprint is the source of truth for every field, so fields cannot contradict each other.
- Blinded diagnostic workup: procedures are ordered by a solver that does not know the diagnosis; a judge checks its final answer.
- Difficulty: `easy`, `medium` or `hard`, enforced by an LLM judge.
- Languages: configured per deployment (`LANGUAGES`, default English and German), with cached, curated-first translations.
- LLM providers: Ollama (local), Google Gemini, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; separate models per role (generator, judge, translator).
- Interfaces: REST API with Server-Sent Events progress streaming, and a durable NATS/JetStream interface with full feature parity.
- Stack: TypeScript, Node.js >= 24.21, LangChain, LangGraph, Express 5, SQLite (Drizzle ORM), NATS, OpenTelemetry.
- Distribution: Docker image `ghcr.io/janthoxo/aetiomed/server`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/janthoXO/AetioMed/blob/main/README.md): what AetioMed is, features, comparison, quick start, generation pipeline, difficulty levels, FAQ
- [Developer Guide](https://github.com/janthoXO/AetioMed/blob/main/README-DEV.md): installation, environment variables, architecture, REST API, NATS API, observability, testing

## API

- [REST API reference](https://github.com/janthoXO/AetioMed/blob/main/README-DEV.md#rest-api): `POST /api/cases` generates a case (blocking JSON or SSE stream); watch, cancel and catalogue endpoints
- [NATS API reference](https://github.com/janthoXO/AetioMed/blob/main/README-DEV.md#nats-api): subjects for requests, results, progress, cancel, status and catalogue reads
- [Request schema](https://github.com/janthoXO/AetioMed/blob/main/src/api/CaseGenerationRequest.ts): Zod schema of a case generation request
